chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Nadr ibn Shu'ayb, from Khalaf ibn Ziyad al-Qalanisi, from a man, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

I heard him saying regarding a man who catches with the Imam in the funeral prayer one takbirah or two takbirahs: he said, he completes the takbir while walking with it. فإذا لم يدرك التكبير he says the takbir at the grave. And if he reaches them after it has already been buried, he says the takbir over the grave.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرَ: the prescribed utterance of Allahu Akbar in this rite
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader in the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْجِنَازَةِ: the funeral bier or funeral procession connected to salat over the deceased
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave, where the missed takbir may be performed
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةً: a single takbir in the funeral prayer
key_terms.دُفِنَ: was buried; indicating the ruling extends even after burial

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he misses some or all of the takbirs in salat over the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who joins the funeral prayer late and misses some of its takbirat. It explains that he should complete the missed takbirat while walking with the جنازة, and if he misses them entirely, he may perform the takbir at the grave, even after burial.
